fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-02-14, around 21:10, the complainant returned to the residence near Arasu Nagar Residential Colony and found the door forced open, with a water pump motor missing, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-02-14. A van bearing the number TN-38-ZZ-1071 was seen leaving the area. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Praveen Natarajan (9000000041) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A further person, Lokesh Balan, a relative of the suspect, using the number 9000000366, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complainant mentioned a vehicle observation and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects reportedly targeted the house while the family was away. A van was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: burglary, house break-in, associate, van, residential colony, witness, photograph, vehicle observation
